## Objective
Calculate correlations between pathologists (majority) grades and ai-derived quantiative features

```{r}
library(jsonlite)
library(tidyverse)
library(ggpubr)

ai_features <- fromJSON(paste0(parsed_features_dir, "original_features_b0.json")) %>%
  mutate(image_fragment_mucosa_name = paste(image_name, fragment_name, mucosa_name, sep = "_")) %>%
  select(image_fragment_mucosa_name, 
         villi_epithelium_lymphocyte_count_per_1000_um2:crypts_lamina_propria_lymphocytes_median_log_closest_junction_um)

majority_grades <- fromJSON("~/Library/CloudStorage/Box-Box/judits_work_keller_lab/fe_si_papers/lymphocyte_distribution_patterns_in_feline_small_intestinal_biopsies/output/pathologists_reproducibility/majority_grades.json") 

combined <- majority_grades%>%
  rename(image_fragment_mucosa_name = name) %>%
  left_join(ai_features) 

distribution_features <- combined %>%
  select(
   - lymphocyte_size,
   - lymphocyte_homogeneity,
   - villi_epithelium_lymphocytes_mean_measured_area_um2,
   - villi_epithelium_lymphocytes_sd_measured_area_um2,
   - crypts_epithelium_lymphocytes_mean_measured_area_um2,
   - crypts_epithelium_lymphocytes_sd_measured_area_um2,
   - villi_lamina_propria_lymphocytes_mean_measured_area_um2,
   - villi_lamina_propria_lymphocytes_sd_measured_area_um2,
   - crypts_lamina_propria_lymphocytes_mean_measured_area_um2,
   - crypts_lamina_propria_lymphocytes_sd_measured_area_um2,
   - villi_epithelium_lamina_propria_ratio
   - crypts_epithelium_lamina_propria_ratio)  %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = matches("^(villi|crypts)_"),
    names_to = c("layer", "compartment", "feature"),
    names_pattern = "^(villi|crypts)_(epithelium|lamina_propria)_(.*)$",
    values_to = "value"
  ) %>%
   mutate(feature = str_remove(feature, "^lymphocytes_")) %>%
  mutate(feature = str_remove(feature, "^lymphocyte_")) %>%
  mutate(feature = ifelse(feature == "junctiona_gradient", "junctional_gradient", feature))
  

morphology_features <- combined %>%
  select(
   lymphocyte_size,
   lymphocyte_homogeneity,
   villi_epithelium_lymphocytes_mean_measured_area_um2,
   villi_epithelium_lymphocytes_sd_measured_area_um2,
   crypts_epithelium_lymphocytes_mean_measured_area_um2,
   crypts_epithelium_lymphocytes_sd_measured_area_um2,
   villi_lamina_propria_lymphocytes_mean_measured_area_um2,
   villi_lamina_propria_lymphocytes_sd_measured_area_um2,
   crypts_lamina_propria_lymphocytes_mean_measured_area_um2,
   crypts_lamina_propria_lymphocytes_sd_measured_area_um2) 
```

#Insights
- Counts correlated better with cellularity than distance to closest neigbor
- Sd Distance to closest neighbor correlated better with clustering then Mean Distance to closest neighbor that c=correlated better with clustering then pct_lymphocytes in clusters
- junctional gradient did NOT correlate with disttance to closest junction (too few and too noisy)
- patchy_infiltration lamina propria did not correlate with anything
- not much correlated in crypt epithelium (but likely too little going on to be measurable)
- patchyness and junctional gradeines had some sig values here and there but likely spurious 

Keep: Count for cellularity, mean and sd distance to closest neighbor for clustering
Drop: " Pct lymphocytes in clusters, lymphocyte_mean_measured_area_um2 and lymphocyte_homogeneity_um2

```{r}

epithelium_comparisons <- tribble(
  ~x, ~y,
  "cellularity", "count_per_1000_um2",
  "cellularity", "mean_log_closest_neighbor_um",
  "clustering", "mean_log_closest_neighbor_um",
  "clustering", "sd_log_closest_neighbor_um",
  "clustering", "pct_cluster_ge_3",
  "junctional_gradient", "median_log_closest_junction_um")

lamina_propria_comparisons <- tribble(
  ~x, ~y,
  "cellularity", "count_per_1000_um2",
  "cellularity", "mean_log_closest_neighbor_um",
  "patchy_infiltration", "mean_log_closest_neighbor_um",
  "patchy_infiltration", "sd_log_closest_neighbor_um",
  "junctional_gradient", "median_log_closest_junction_um")


#— 2. Pivot back to wide:
wide_df <- distribution_features %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from  = feature,
    values_from = value
  )

#— 3. A helper to run a single set of ANOVAs & plots for one compartment:
run_comparisons <- function(df, comps, layer_name, comp_name) {
  comps %>% pwalk(function(x, y) {
    df_sub <- df %>% 
      filter(!is.na(.data[[x]]), !is.na(.data[[y]]))
    
    # 3a. ANOVA
    cat("\n--", toupper(layer_name), "/", comp_name, "ANOVA:", x, "vs", y, "--\n")
    print(summary(aov(as.formula(paste(y, "~ factor(", x, ")")), data = df_sub)))
    
    # 3b. Boxplot with stars
    top <- max(df_sub[[y]], na.rm = TRUE) * 1.05
    p <- ggplot(df_sub, aes_string(x = paste0("factor(", x, ")"), y = y)) +
      geom_boxplot() +
      stat_compare_means(
        method  = "anova",
        label   = "p.signif",
        label.y = top
      ) +
      labs(
        title = paste(layer_name, comp_name, ":", x, "vs", y),
        x     = x,
        y     = y
      ) +
      theme_minimal()
    
    print(p)
  })
}

#— 4. Loop over each layer:
for (layer_name in unique(wide_df$layer)) {
  df_layer <- wide_df %>% filter(layer == layer_name)
  
  # epithelium
  df_epi <- df_layer %>% filter(compartment == "epithelium")
  run_comparisons(df_epi, epithelium_comparisons, layer_name, "epithelium")
  
  # lamina_propria
  df_lp <- df_layer %>% filter(compartment == "lamina_propria")
  run_comparisons(df_lp, lamina_propria_comparisons, layer_name, "lamina_propria")
}


```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(purrr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggpubr)

# 1. Pull out just the comparisons we want
means  <- c(
  "villi_epithelium_lymphocytes_mean_measured_area_um2",
  "crypts_epithelium_lymphocytes_mean_measured_area_um2",
  "villi_lamina_propria_lymphocytes_mean_measured_area_um2",
  "crypts_lamina_propria_lymphocytes_mean_measured_area_um2"
)

sds    <- c(
  "villi_epithelium_lymphocytes_sd_measured_area_um2",
  "crypts_epithelium_lymphocytes_sd_measured_area_um2",
  "villi_lamina_propria_lymphocytes_sd_measured_area_um2",
  "crypts_lamina_propria_lymphocytes_sd_measured_area_um2"
)

# 2. A helper to run one ANOVA + boxplot
run_test <- function(df, x_var, y_var, method = "anova") {
  df2 <- df %>% filter(!is.na(.data[[x_var]]), !is.na(.data[[y_var]]))
  
  # ANOVA
  cat("\n**Testing**", y_var, "~", x_var, "\n")
  model <- aov(as.formula(paste(y_var, "~ factor(", x_var, ")")), data = df2)
  print(summary(model))
  
  # Boxplot with stars
  top <- max(df2[[y_var]], na.rm = TRUE) * 1.05
  p <- ggplot(df2, aes_string(x = paste0("factor(", x_var, ")"), y = y_var)) +
    geom_boxplot() +
    stat_compare_means(
      method  = method,
      label   = "p.signif",
      label.y = top
    ) +
    labs(
      title = paste0(x_var, " vs. ", y_var),
      x     = x_var,
      y     = y_var
    ) +
    theme_minimal()
  
  print(p)
}

# 3. Run means ~ size
walk(means, function(me) {
  run_test(morphology_features, "lymphocyte_size", me, method = "anova")
})

# 4. Run sds ~ homogeneity
walk(sds, function(sd) {
  run_test(morphology_features, "lymphocyte_homogeneity", sd, method = "anova")
})
```

```{r}
comparisons %>% 
  pwalk(function(x, y) {
    # subset & drop NAs
    df <- combined %>% 
      filter(!is.na(.data[[x]]), !is.na(.data[[y]]))
    
    cat("\n\n>>> ANOVA for", y, "by", x, ":\n")
    model <- aov(as.formula(paste(y, "~ factor(", x, ")")), data = df)
    print(summary(model))
    
    # determine where to put the stars
    top <- max(df[[y]], na.rm = TRUE) * 1.05
    
    # boxplot with stars
    p <- ggplot(df, aes_string(x = paste0("factor(", x, ")"), y = y)) +
      geom_boxplot() +
      stat_compare_means(
        method    = "anova", 
        label     = "p.signif", 
        label.y   = top
      ) +
      labs(
        x = x, 
        y = y,
        title = paste("ANOVA p-stars for", y, "∼", x)
      ) +
      theme_minimal()
    
    print(p)
  })
```
